fields.label: Source and theorem
fields.text: Transcribed bound: KLPR2022 Lemma 4 Eq. (6) and Eq. (11) (bound P-S2/priv). Outstanding obligation: statistical test of issuer location-inference advantage under the defined privacy game.

fields.label: Assumptions
items: As P-S2 Table 6 C-F (reporting strategy leaks nothing about W, z); Alice honest.

fields.label: Parameters
fields.text:
beta_E: bias of Alice's bit z
M: log2 number of presentation points

fields.label: Quantifier over adversaries
fields.text: any strategy of Bob before Alice's presentation, under Table 6 C-F

fields.label: Caveats
items: Privacy has NO theorem for W1, W1_CV, S1 (ideal; prose only), D1 (MAC hides merchant; no epsilon stated), A1, C1: the evaluator returns UNSUPPORTED with value None, never 0.
